jobs.title: AI Program Manager
jobs.description: Are you looking for an opportunity to help solve one of today's biggest business challenges? AI is changing the pace of business, and organizations everywhere are struggling to help their workforce, partners, and customers keep up. At Litmos, we're building the Learning Acceleration Platform that helps organizations build human capability faster—and we're looking for people who are passionate about making a meaningful impact for customers while growing alongside a collaborative, people-first team. Litmos is the Learning Acceleration Platform that helps organizations build capability faster, adapt at the speed business changes, and scale learning to anyone, anywhere. Combining an intuitive platform, AI-powered capabilities, trusted content, expert services, and a broad ecosystem of integrations, Litmos helps organizations accelerate workforce productivity, improve customer adoption and retention, enable high-performing partners, and reduce organizational risk through continuous learning. Organizations such as Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Graco, Sabre, and Russell Mineral Equipment trust Litmos to accelerate learning across their workforce, partners, and customers. Today, more than 11K customers with 30 million learners across 150 countries and 37 languages use Litmos to build the capabilities their organizations need to succeed. Backed by Francisco Partners, one of the world's leading technology investment firms, we're investing in the future of learning—and the people who are building it. Learn more at www.litmos.com . We are seeking an AI Program Manager to coordinate AI-related projects across internal teams such as Finance, Product, and Customer Success. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role responsible for keeping AI initiatives on track—planning, scheduling, and driving projects to completion, and helping teams build their own AI skills along the way. You will be the day-to-day point of contact who keeps cross-functional Agentic work moving, surfaces risks early, and ensures teams have the information they need to make decisions. This role coordinates the people and projects that put AI to work across the business; it does not involve hands-on development of AI models or applications (e.g., RAG pipelines, LLM development). You will apply core program and project management practices—scoping, scheduling, risk tracking, status reporting, and stakeholder communication—to a portfolio of related AI initiatives owned by business teams, ensuring individual projects ladder up to shared program goals, and you will identify, propose, and lead projects that help advance the organization toward becoming an agentic-first operational organization. This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams and stakeholders simultaneously. Key Responsibilities AI Project Tracking & Coordination across the Litmos organization Maintain an up-to-date tracking of active AI projects across business teams (e.g., Finance, Product, Customer Success), including status, timelines, dependencies, and owners Support intake and scheduling of new AI project requests from business teams; help prioritize work based on direction from project sponsors and leadership Track resource needs across AI projects and flag scheduling conflicts to the relevant business leads and managers Organize and run regular status check-ins and working sessions with project teams Identify and sequence dependencies across projects within the program, flagging where one project's timeline or output affects another Prepare status summaries and materials for leadership review of project progress and risks Program Execution & Tools Apply project management practices—project plans, timelines, RAID logs, and status templates—to AI initiatives led by business teams Maintain templates, trackers, and runbooks for common types of AI projects (e.g., workflow automation, agentic tooling rollouts) to keep execution consistent Support day-to-day collaboration between business stakeholders and any technical partners involved in a project; clarify roles, timelines, and next steps Onboard project team members to established tools and processes; answer process questions and provide day-to-day coaching Risk & Issue Tracking Log and track project-level risks and issues (e.g., delays, resourcing, adoption barriers) and follow up on assigned mitigation actions Coordinate with security, compliance, and legal teams to schedule any required reviews and confirm approvals are completed on time Track completion of required checkpoints (e.g., data access approvals, tool onboarding, training) ahead of project milestones Maintain checklists confirming projects have completed necessary internal review steps before key milestones Skill Development & Enablement Partner with business teams (Finance, Product, Customer Success, and others) to assess AI skill gaps and coordinate training, tools, and resources to close them Track individual and team progress on AI upskilling plans; maintain a simple skills/readiness tracker across groups Maintain a shared knowledge base of AI project templates, playbooks, and FAQs for use by other teams Document lessons learned and best practices from completed projects; share broadly to support future initiatives Cross-Functional Coordination & Integration Serve as the day-to-day point of contact between AI project teams and business stakeholders across Finance, Product, Customer Success, and other groups Track and follow up on dependencies and handoffs between AI projects and related initiatives Schedule and support cross-functional working sessions; take notes, track action items, and follow up to closure Relay updates between teams to keep everyone aligned on progress Status Reporting & Metrics Maintain dashboards and trackers showing project status, milestones, and key metrics across the AI project portfolio Compile regular status reports summarizing progress, risks, and blockers for stakeholders and leadership Maintain a program-level roadmap and recurring cross-project sync so reporting reflects how individual projects fit into the broader AI program Track adoption and usage metrics for completed AI and agentic-workflow initiatives Flag emerging risks or delays proactively so leadership and sponsors can make timely decisions Agentic-First Initiative Development Identify opportunities within business teams to introduce agentic workflows or AI-assisted processes; propose and scope candidate projects Take ownership of select projects end-to-end, from proposal through execution, that advance the organization's shift toward an agentic-first operating model Identify recurring process bottlenecks and suggest practical improvements to project tracking and coordination Share feedback and status updates with program leadership to support broader AI portfolio planning Qualifications and Key Competencies 4-5+ years of experience in program or project management, coordinating cross-functional business or technology projects Experience managing a portfolio or program of related projects, not just a single project at a time Experience coordinating projects with business teams such as Finance, Product, or Customer Success Working knowledge of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Smartsheet) and practices (timelines, RAID logs, status reporting) Basic familiarity with AI and agentic tools and workflows, sufficient to coordinate projects and support team upskilling (no hands-on model-building experience required) Experience supporting training, upskilling, or change-management efforts within a business team Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and deadlines Clear written and verbal communication skills; comfortable coordinating across technical and non-technical stakeholders Detail-oriented with strong follow-through on action items and deliverables Nice to Have PMP or similar project management certification Experience with change management or training program coordination Familiarity with agentic AI tools or workflow automation platforms Experience with compliance or governance tracking processes Exposure to Agile/Scrum project delivery methods Experience in fast-growing organizations undergoing AI adoption Salary Range: $120,000 - $150,000 plus 20% bonus Benefits:- Litmos offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes, but is not limited to: Health, dental, and vision insurance Paid Time Off Retirement savings plan (401k) with company match Life insurance Short term & Long-term Disability Paid family leave Employee assistance programs (EAP) As a learning company we believe in the potential of everyone; if you don't have experience in all the details mentioned in this job post, then we still encourage you to apply and we'll get back to you as soon as we can. We are an equal opportunity workplace employer. We are committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provide accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability.

jobs.description: Director, Program Management - Catalog AI & Quality (Taiwan Relocation) Description Company Introduction Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door. Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond. We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Role Overview Coupang Taiwan is looking for a highly technical Program Management leader to reimagine catalog quality and catalog operations through AI and LLM-powered solutions. This role sits at the intersection of Program Management, Product Management, Data, and AI. The successful candidate will lead the design and implementation of scalable workflows that automatically identify, evaluate, and resolve catalog quality issues across millions of product listings. Unlike traditional program management roles, this position requires a hands-on builder mindset. The ideal candidate is comfortable leveraging LLMs, designing data pipelines, creating MVPs with small teams, and rapidly scaling successful solutions across the organization.
